parent.title: Users can reset a forgotten password

criteria.text: User can request a reset link by email
Reset links expire after one hour
User can set a new password from the link
At most 5 reset requests per email per hour

slices.title: Request a link and set a new password
slices.value: A locked-out user gets back in without support

criteria.text: Submitting a known email sends one link
Following the link and submitting a password logs the user in

slices.title: Expire reset links after one hour
slices.value: A leaked old email cannot be used to take over an account

criteria.text: A 61-minute-old token is rejected with a clear message

slices.title: Rate-limit reset requests
slices.value: Users are not spammed with reset emails
scope: Count requests per email per hour

criteria.text: The 6th request in an hour returns 429
